decisive_items: Orbital abscess extending from right-sided rhinosinusitis through superior maxillary sinus wall
disease extending around mandibular ramus into parotid
response.rationale: Imaging explicitly identifies an orbital abscess arising from rhinosinusitis, with local extension explaining the facial nerve and trigeminal findings. Rhinosinusitis is the underlying source but less specific; cavernous sinus syndrome lacks supporting ophthalmoplegia or cavernous sinus imaging findings.

rejected.why: No cavernous sinus involvement is demonstrated; facial paresis is better explained by parotid/infratemporal extension, and no ophthalmoplegia is described.
Rhinosinusitis is present as the source, but the most specific and clinically dominant diagnosis is the orbital abscess complication.
